title: enhanced-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflow-optimizations
author: Ava Chen
description: Improvements to unified rollouts: refine autorollback sensitivity, add a quarantine probing stage, composite-metric quorum support, and enhanced observability for canary / A-B / shadow workflows. Motivation: recent incidents showed noise in single-metric triggers caused premature rollbacks for low-traffic canaries and noisy downstream metrics. This PR introduces (1) a lightweight probing/quarantine stage that isolates unstable metric signals, (2) composite-metric quorum evaluation to avoid single-metric flapping, (3) configurable hysteresis and cooldown for rollback decisions, (4) new telemetry events and dashboards for rollback investigations, and (5) e2e integration tests and migration notes for operators. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked - [x] Implementation for rollout controller + autorollback engine - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] E2E stability tests (simulated noisy metrics) - [x] Docs + release notes - [x] Feature flag gated rollout (default on for canary workflow) Migration notes: operators should review rollout policies that reference single-metric thresholds and consider switching to composite metrics or enabling quarantine probing. See linear tasks for rollout strategy and canary tuning.
commits: 3 commits: 1) controller: add quarantine probing stage and composite-metric evaluator; 2) autorollback: add hysteresis/cooldown and metric quorum logic; 3) tests/docs: add e2e scenarios and docs. Commit messages are concise and reference Linear tasks (ENG-4523, ENG-4531).
ci_checks: CI run: unit-tests (passed), integration-tests (passed after two retries), e2e-sim (passed), lint (failed on first run due to formatting, fixed and re-run), build (passed). Flaky tests: rollout_controller/flaky_metric_simulation retried and stabilized in the final run.
review_summary: Initial review requested clearer invariants for quarantine transitions and suggested a small refactor to keep evaluator pure. Author responded with a follow-up commit to extract composite metric logic into a testable package and added more unit tests. Security requested a short audit of telemetry payloads; we limited telemetry to rollout IDs and metric summaries (no PII). Final approvals: Diego (LGTM), Priya (LGTM), Laura (approved). Marcus requested a minor docs tweak which was addressed in the final commit.
release_notes:
- Improve autorollback stability: added quarantine probing stage and composite-metric quorum evaluation to reduce false positives.
- Config: new hysteresis and cooldown keys for rollback decisions.
- Observability: new dashboards and telemetry events for rollback investigations.
Operators: review rollout policies referencing single-metric thresholds and consider migration to composite or enable quarantine probing.
notes: Feature is gated by feature flag rollouts.quarantine_probing. Default: enabled for canary workflows in managed stacks. Operators on Dedicated/Private can toggle via infra/flags/feature_flags.yaml.
known_issues: Edge case: extremely low-sample traffic (<<10 requests/min) can still produce noisy metric snapshots; the quarantine stage will extend probing but operators should tune min_sample_size. We added an optional 'force-evaluate' operator override for emergency rollbacks.
impact_summary: Decreases false positive rollbacks in noisy environments, increases rollout stability for low-traffic canaries, and provides richer telemetry to accelerate post-rollback investigations. Small CPU overhead in controller from composite evaluations (~2-3% observed in perf lab).
